summary: Multi-skilled professional with comprehensive HR knowledge, adept at recruitment, employee relations, and confidential matters. Experienced in providing timely HR advice to managers and staff while balancing employee and employer interests.

experience.title: HR Services Representative
responsibilities: Managed end‑to‑end recruitment, including job offers, contracts, and onboarding.
Conducted pre/post‑employment checks and processed security references.
Handled employee enrollment, updates, and benefit plan changes.
Processed leave requests and coordinated with managers on promotions and transfers.
Prepared offer letters, employment contracts, and reference letters.
Maintained employee records in system databases and ensured accurate time‑clock registration.
Provided HR support to staff and customers via phone and in‑person.
Collaborated with department managers on recruitment, leave, and benefits queries.
Managed documentation, scanned files, and maintained electronic records.

experience.title: Teller / Customer Service Representative (HEART Trainee)
responsibilities: Opened accounts and processed member transactions as a teller.
Assisted members with branch services and product information.
Prepared and filed transaction vouchers, utility payment vouchers, and loan vouchers.
Managed daily cash deposit listings and document filing.
Coordinated member registrations and handled faxing of signature cards.
Prepared correspondence to customers and suppliers.
